defaults.title: Defaults for everyone
defaults.help: People who leave a row on Default get these. Changes apply right away.
defaults.info: What everyone gets for audio and subtitles until they choose their own in Babelfin Settings. "Video default" leaves the track to the video file (or to the person's Jellyfin playback settings).

people.copiedSkipped: Settings copied, except {count} titles the other person can't see.
field.UnlabelledAudio.info: Some video files don't say what language an audio track is in, so Babelfin can't match the track to anyone's languages. This tells Babelfin what to assume. "The title's original language, when it's the only audio track" suits most libraries. Choose a specific language only if all such tracks on this server are in that language.
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.restoreConfirm: Apps and Track recognition go back to their defaults. New users languages and all other settings stay as they are.
apps.title: Apps
apps.mode: When the app asks for specific tracks
apps.mode.info:
Apps often ask for specific tracks, such as the ones used in the previous episode.
"Keep the app's choice" plays what the app asked for.
"Use Babelfin's choice when playing the next episode" replaces only the tracks an app carries over to the next episode.
"Use Babelfin's choice unless changed by hand" replaces everything except a track someone picked by hand.
apps.mode.ReplaceOnAutoplay: Use Babelfin's choice when playing the next episode
apps.mode.ReplaceUnlessManual: Use Babelfin's choice unless changed by hand
apps.notListed.info: Used for any app that isn't in the list above.
option.correctAfterStart: Fix tracks after playback starts when an app ignores the choice
option.correctAfterStart.info: Some apps start playing with their own tracks anyway. Babelfin then switches them to its choice once, right after playback starts, in apps that allow it.
option.compatibility: Also save choices as Jellyfin's remembered tracks
option.compatibility.info: Also writes Babelfin's choice into Jellyfin's own remembered tracks for each video, for apps that choose tracks themselves from those. Turning it off puts Jellyfin's remembered tracks back as they were.
unlabelled.OriginalWhenOnlyTrack: The title's original language, when it's the only audio track
template.title: New users start with
template.info: The languages a new person starts with until they choose their own. "From their Jellyfin settings" uses the audio and subtitle languages in their Jellyfin playback settings.
recognition.title: Track recognition
tracknames.title: Track names
tracknames.help: Babelfin reads track titles to tell what kind of track each one is. For example, a subtitle track titled "English Signs" is signs and songs, and "English SDH" is for the deaf and hard of hearing. Add the words your files use, one per line.
codes.title: Language codes
codes.help: Some files label tracks with codes Babelfin doesn't recognize, such as "jap" or "English (US)". Add each one with the language it means, or mark it as not a language.

reset.title: Reset all settings
reset.help: Resets this page and each person's settings to the shipped defaults. A recovery backup is saved first. Settings that cannot be loaded are kept and reported. To edit and restore your own copy, download all settings first.
reset.confirmText: Reset server settings and user settings to the shipped defaults? A recovery backup is saved first. Accounts whose settings cannot be loaded are skipped. Any skipped or failed accounts will be reported.
reset.done: All settings were reset. A copy of the previous settings is on the server: {path}
reset.partial: Reset with problems: {names}. Their settings or Jellyfin remember flags could not be fully reset. A copy of the previous settings is on the server: {path}

apps.rememberPrePlay.info: Turn this on only if the app fills its audio and subtitle pickers from Jellyfin's defaults. Choices changed before playback will then be remembered. Changes made during playback can be remembered in any app.
